name: Cocktail
description: Cocktail is a comprehensive information retrieval benchmark designed to evaluate IR models on mixed human-written and LLM-generated content across diverse datasets and domains. It includes 16 datasets and a new up-to-date dataset (NQ-UTD) with recent event queries to study the impact of AI-generated content on retrieval performance.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that is starting to be cited in IR research, but it has not yet had time to become a widely established community standard.
notes: Focuses on IR in the presence of LLM-generated content; includes diverse datasets and recent queries; publicly available.
